001package bank.model;
002
003import java.math.BigDecimal;
004
005/**
006 * ============================================================================
007 *  LoanAccount.java
008 *  Owner: Abdul Rahman Fornah (afornah1@umbc.edu)
009 * ============================================================================
010 *
011 *  RULES FOR THIS ACCOUNT TYPE:
012 *      - Balance represents debt and is stored as a NEGATIVE number.
013 *      - Interest is charged monthly, increasing the debt (making the balance
014 *        more negative).
015 *      - Deposits (credits) reduce the debt.
016 *      - Direct withdrawals (debits) are not permitted from a loan account.
017 * ============================================================================
018 */
019public class LoanAccount extends Account {
020
021    /** Annual interest rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.06 represents 6%). */
022    private BigDecimal interestRate = new BigDecimal("0.06");
023
024    /** No-argument constructor required for Gson deserialization. */
025    protected LoanAccount() { }
026
027    /**
028     * Initializes a new LoanAccount.
029     * 
030     * @param id The account identifier.
031     * @param initialDebt The starting debt (should be provided as a negative value).
032     * @param annualInterestRate The annual interest rate as a decimal.
033     */
034    public LoanAccount(String id, BigDecimal initialDebt, BigDecimal annualInterestRate) {
035        super("LOAN", id, initialDebt);
036        this.interestRate = annualInterestRate;
037    }
038
039    /**
040     * Rejects all debit attempts, as funds cannot be withdrawn from a loan.
041     *
042     * @param amount The amount to debit.
043     * @throws IllegalStateException Always thrown to prevent withdrawals.
044     */
045    @Override
046    public BigDecimal debit(BigDecimal amount) {
047        throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid Operation: Withdrawals are not permitted from a loan account.");
048    }
049
050    /**
051     * Calculates the monthly interest rate based on the annual rate.
052     * 
053     * @return The monthly interest rate (Annual Rate / 12).
054     */
055    @Override
056    public BigDecimal getMonthlyInterestRate() {
057        return interestRate.divide(new BigDecimal("12"), 6, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
058    }
059
060    public BigDecimal getAnnualInterestRate() {
061        return interestRate;
062    }
063
064    /** 
065     * Calculates the absolute amount of debt remaining.
066     * 
067     * @return The outstanding debt as a positive BigDecimal.
068     */
069    public BigDecimal getOutstandingDebt() {
070        return balance.abs();
071    }
072}
